text.p: EuroAmerican Group Inc, a satellite data delivery company, said on Wednesday it completed the acquisition of Tenfore Systems Ltd and Tenfore R&D ApS.

The company said it had issued 170,000 shares of its newly designated series B non-voting convertible preferred stock and options to acquire 35,000 additional shares of the preferred stock. The options are exercisable at $20 per share, it said, and each share of the preferred stock automatically converts into 100 shares of the company's common stock on January 31, 2000.
The preferred stock is not convertible before that date, except in the event of an extraordinary corporate action, the company said.
EuroAmerican predicted the acquisition would bring about substantial reductions in its cost of disseminating financial data, both companies' single largest expense.
"We expect the integration of the companies to take from six to nine months," added Alexis Charamis, EuroAmerican's chief executive officer.

He said the company will need to raise about $3 million to finance the costs of the integration and operations during that period and that it is working with its investment bankers to find additional sources of capital.
The new operations will initially keep the Tenfore and EuroAmerican brands separate, running on a "business as usual" basis, the company said.
Tenfore is a real-time provider of targeted financial information.
